stem.text: Which diagram shows the pattern of the electric field between a positively charged metal sphere and a negatively charged metal plate?

A.alt: Straight field lines fanning out from the positive sphere to the negative plate, with arrows pointing down towards the plate

B.alt: Curved field lines from the positive sphere to the negative plate, with arrows pointing down towards the plate

C.alt: Straight field lines fanning out from the positive sphere to the plate, with arrows pointing up towards the sphere

D.alt: Curved field lines from the plate to the positive sphere, with arrows pointing up towards the sphere
